summary: Parks! America, Inc. via its wholly owned subsidiary Aggieland-Parks, Inc. entered a loan modification with Cendera Bank refinancing a $2.33M term loan maturing June 2033. The loan carries SOFR+2.70% floating rate swapped to a fixed 6.99% via a rate conversion with SouthState Bank. The facility is secured by subsidiary assets, guaranteed by the parent, and removes a $2.5M cash collateral reserve. No corporate event triggering a special situation classification; routine debt restructuring.
